name: AntiFake Mate – Phone Blocker
author: Sm_Rasmy

sections.description:
AntiFake Mate is a WooCommerce plugin designed to prevent specific phone numbers from placing orders. By blocking certain numbers, this plugin helps maintain the integrity of your store and reduces fraudulent activities. It also counts the number of blocked attempts, providing valuable insights into potential issues.

Key Features

  • Phone Number Blocking: Easily block specific phone numbers from placing orders in your WooCommerce store.
  • Attempt Tracking: Track and count the number of blocked attempts per phone number to identify potential fraud.
  • Admin Management: Manage blocked numbers directly from the WooCommerce settings page, with options to add and delete numbers.
  • Arabic Number Support: Automatically convert Arabic numbers to English to ensure accurate blocking regardless of format.

How to Use AntiFake Mate

  1. Install and activate the AntiFake Mate plugin.
  2. Navigate to WooCommerce > Phone Blocker in your WordPress admin panel.
  3. Add phone numbers to the blocked list as needed.
  4. The plugin will automatically block any orders placed with these numbers during the checkout process.

Usage

  1. After activation, go to WooCommerce > Phone Blocker to manage blocked phone numbers.
  2. Add phone numbers you wish to block. You can also delete numbers from the list.
  3. Any orders placed with blocked phone numbers will be denied, and attempts will be counted for reporting.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file from the AntiFake Mate plugin page.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  4. Click Upload Plugin, select the downloaded zip file, and click Install Now.
  5. Once installed, activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
sections.faq:
Q: Can I block multiple phone numbers at once?

A: Currently, you can add one phone number at a time. Future versions may include bulk add functionality.

Q: Will customers see a message when their phone number is blocked?

A: Yes, customers attempting to place orders with a blocked number will see an error message during checkout.

Q: Does this plugin support international phone formats?

A: Yes, the plugin normalizes phone numbers to ensure consistent formatting for effective blocking, including support for Arabic numbers.
